claim: The tracer particles are excited at 620 nm, as specified by the supplier for the product family.
validity_conditions: As with the emission peak, a band reported as a point: no width is printed, so none is asserted. Diameter-independent. WHETHER THIS LINE CAN ACTUALLY BE DELIVERED IS A SEPARATE QUESTION and is not answered here -- which light engine reaches the sample, and at what wavelength, lives in kb/staging/devices.v0.json under light_engines, and the lapp_branch_assignment gap there is still open. A tracer that is excitable at 620 nm and an instrument that can excite it are two facts, and only the first is on this data sheet.
